from datetime import datetime
import os

# login
pw=[a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
tok=apis.file_system.login(username='susanmiller@gmail.com', password=pw)['access_token']

base_dir=os.path.expanduser('~/photographs/vacations')
files=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=tok, directory_path=base_dir, entry_type='files', recursive=False)
print('base_dir', base_dir)
print('initial_file_count', len(files))

current_year=datetime.now().year
print('current_year', current_year)

# classify by created_at month/year
athens=[]
seoul=[]
paris=[]
for p in files:
    info=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=tok, file_path=p)
    dt=datetime.fromisoformat(info['created_at'])
    name=os.path.basename(p)
    if dt.year==current_year and dt.month==1:
        athens.append(p)
    elif dt.year==current_year and dt.month==4:
        seoul.append(p)
    else:
        paris.append(p)

print('classified_counts', {'Athens': len(athens), 'Seoul': len(seoul), 'Paris': len(paris)})
print('athens_files', [os.path.basename(p) for p in athens])
print('seoul_files', [os.path.basename(p) for p in seoul])
print('paris_files', [os.path.basename(p) for p in paris])

# Ensure destination dirs exist
for sd in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']:
    dest=os.path.join(base_dir, sd)
    resp=apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=tok, directory_path=dest)
    if not resp['exists']:
        apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=tok, directory_path=dest, recursive=True, allow_if_exists=True)

# move files
moved=[]
for group_name, group in [('Athens', athens), ('Seoul', seoul), ('Paris', paris)]:
    for src in group:
        filename=os.path.basename(src)
        dst=os.path.join(base_dir, group_name, filename)
        resp=apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=tok, source_file_path=src, destination_file_path=dst, overwrite=False, retain_dates=True)
        moved.append((filename, group_name, src, dst, resp.get('message')))
print('moved_count', len(moved))
print('moved_preview', moved[:5])

# verify
remaining=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=tok, directory_path=base_dir, entry_type='files', recursive=False)
print('remaining_in_base', len(remaining))
for sd in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']:
    dest=os.path.join(base_dir, sd)
    in_sd=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=tok, directory_path=dest, entry_type='files', recursive=False)
    print('files_in', sd, len(in_sd), [os.path.basename(p) for p in in_sd][:10])

import os
from datetime import datetime

# Login file_system
pw=[a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
tok=apis.file_system.login(username='susanmiller@gmail.com', password=pw)['access_token']
base_dir='~/photographs/vacations/'

# List files (non-recursive)
files=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=tok, directory_path=base_dir, entry_type='files', recursive=False)
print('base_dir', base_dir)
print('initial_files_count', len(files))
print('first_file', files[0] if files else None)

# Determine absolute base path from returned file paths
base_abs=os.path.dirname(files[0]) if files else os.path.expanduser('~/photographs/vacations')
print('base_abs', base_abs)

current_year=datetime.now().year
print('current_year', current_year)

# Classify by created_at month/year
athens=[]
seoul=[]
paris=[]
for src in files:
    info=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=tok, file_path=src)
    dt=datetime.fromisoformat(info['created_at'])
    name=os.path.basename(src)
    if dt.year==current_year and dt.month==1:
        athens.append(src)
    elif dt.year==current_year and dt.month==4:
        seoul.append(src)
    else:
        paris.append(src)

print('classified_counts', {'Athens':len(athens),'Seoul':len(seoul),'Paris':len(paris)})
print('athens_files', [os.path.basename(p) for p in athens])
print('seoul_files', [os.path.basename(p) for p in seoul])
print('paris_files', [os.path.basename(p) for p in paris])

# Ensure destination directories exist (absolute paths)
dests={
    'Athens': os.path.join(base_abs, 'Athens'),
    'Seoul': os.path.join(base_abs, 'Seoul'),
    'Paris': os.path.join(base_abs, 'Paris')
}

for k, d in dests.items():
    exists=apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=tok, directory_path=d)['exists']
    print('dest', k, 'exists_before', exists, 'path', d)
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=tok, directory_path=d, recursive=True, allow_if_exists=True)
    exists2=apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=tok, directory_path=d)['exists']
    print('dest', k, 'exists_after', exists2)

# Move files preserving names
moved=[]
for group, src_list in [('Athens', athens), ('Seoul', seoul), ('Paris', paris)]:
    for src in src_list:
        filename=os.path.basename(src)
        dst=os.path.join(dests[group], filename)
        resp=apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=tok, source_file_path=src, destination_file_path=dst, overwrite=False, retain_dates=True)
        moved.append((group, filename, src, resp.get('destination_file_path')))

print('moved_count', len(moved))
print('moved_groups_counts', {g:sum(1 for x in moved if x[0]==g) for g in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']})
print('moved_preview', moved[:5])

# Verify
remaining_base=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=tok, directory_path=base_abs, entry_type='files', recursive=False)
print('remaining_base_files_count', len(remaining_base))
for group in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']:
    dirp=dests[group]
    files_in=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=tok, directory_path=dirp, entry_type='files', recursive=False)
    print('files_in', group, len(files_in), [os.path.basename(p) for p in files_in][:10])
